user.title: Waste Collection
user.description: Adds the collection routes and the receptacle inventory. Set each stream's pickup day afterwards under Configure, and add bins with Add receptacle.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Waste Collection is already set up.

trash.title: Trash schedule
trash.description: Leave a field empty if you do not know it yet. Nothing is guessed: with no pickup day the next-pickup sensor stays unknown and says why, rather than showing a date nobody chose.

data_description.anchor: Only used for every-other-week, to fix which week is the on week. Any date the truck actually came will do.

recycling.title: Recycling schedule
recycling.description: Same again for recycling. Every-other-week recycling is common where trash is weekly.

data_description.anchor: Only used for every-other-week, to fix which week is the on week. Any date the truck actually came will do.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.description: Dates the trucks do not run. A pickup in the same Monday-to-Sunday week as a holiday, on or after it, moves later by the shift -- once per holiday ahead of it that week. Enter each as YYYY-MM-DD; a Sunday holiday goes in as the Monday it is observed on.

data.holiday_shift_days: Days a pickup moves per holiday

data_description.holidays: The observed dates, one per line. Leave empty for none.
data_description.holiday_shift_days: One day is the usual municipal rule. Zero turns the rule off without losing the list.

error.unknown_value: Not a date this integration can read. Use YYYY-MM-DD.

add.title: Add a receptacle
add.description: A bin somewhere in the house. It gets its own device, so you can assign it to an area afterwards the same way as any other device.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Sets one stream's pickup day, cadence or every-other-week anchor. Fields left out are not changed; send an empty value to clear one. An unrecognised day or cadence is refused rather than ignored, so a wall panel is told when a schedule did not save.

weekday.name: Pickup day
weekday.description: The day the truck comes. Leave empty to clear it.

cadence.name: How often
cadence.description: Every week, or every other week.

anchor.name: A date it was collected
anchor.description: Only used for every-other-week, to fix which week is the on week. Any date the truck actually came will do.

set_holidays.name: Set holidays
set_holidays.description: Replaces the list of dates the trucks do not run, and/or how many days a pickup moves for each holiday ahead of it in its week. The list is sent whole; an empty list clears it.

holidays.name: Holiday dates
holidays.description: Every observed holiday date, as YYYY-MM-DD. Replaces the stored list.

holiday_shift_days.name: Shift per holiday
holiday_shift_days.description: Days a pickup moves later for each holiday on or before it in the same week. Zero turns the rule off.

set_override.name: Set pickup override
set_override.description: Moves or skips one stream's pickup on one scheduled date, or clears an earlier override. Keyed on the date the schedule put it on, before any holiday shift.

date.name: Scheduled date
date.description: The date the schedule alone would give for this pickup.

replacement.name: Happens on
replacement.description: The date the truck will actually come instead.

skip.name: Skip
skip.description: The pickup does not happen at all. Cannot be combined with a replacement.

clear.name: Clear
clear.description: Forget any override on this date and go back to the schedule.

no_entry.message: Waste Collection is not set up, so there is no schedule to change.

unknown_value.message: {field} is not a value Waste Collection recognises: {value}. Nothing was changed.
